dialogue.line: Nice job. Now you have two questions to work with: who is commemorated by this tombstone, and how did they die?
I have no idea how to approach this.

Don't worry. I've translated some manuscripts to help with your work. You'll find them under the Manuscripts tab. Translation takes time, so I'll send more from time to time, choosing the pieces most relevant to your progress.
Thanks. I'll take some time to read them. Talk to you later.
